name: Enervation Fortitude [Psionic]
body:
You have learned how to better handle psychic enervation.

Prerequisite: Psychic enervation class feature.

Benefit: When you suffer psychic enervation, the penalties are calculated as if your wilder level were reduced by half (to a minimum of 1).
